MEET THE FOUNDER

Lance Morgan

Lance is a best-selling author and a college-funding strategist with more than 20 years in the financial industry, and he's a dad of five. For years he saved in 529s and taught clients to do the same. As his own kids got closer to college, he saw that tuition couldn't be planned apart from taxes and retirement, and the tax side is where he found a better way to pay. That's the framework the team walks through with you on the review.
